sections.title: The hard sign
paragraphs: The letter name is (твёрдый знак) /ˈtvʲɵrdɨj ˈznak/. This letter has no sound of its own. It acts as a separator in words like (объект) /ɐbˈjekt/, which means object. Because it never makes a sound, it has zero sounds to learn.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Your mouth makes no sound for this letter. You make the preceding sound firmly. Then you add a tiny break before the next sound. Touch your throat to feel that your voice stops briefly during the separation.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: This letter is not pronounced. You find it between a prefix that ends in a consonant and a following vowel. The letter keeps the preceding consonant hard, as in (подъезд) /pɐdˈjest/. It also appears in short forms such as (съел) /sjel/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not blend the preceding consonant into the following vowel like the word union. Keep the first consonant firm and separate. Say the sounds with a clear break, like the jump in sub-unit.
